name: Vibrant Surge
body:
Prerequisite(s): Sprig race, Growth Surge racial ability

Benefit(s): When you use your Growth Surge ability, your vibrant energy overflows, affecting your allies. All allies within 10 feet of you when you activate Growth Surge gain a +1 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws for the duration of your Growth Surge.

Special: If you have the Extra Beasty feat, you can use this ability an additional time per day for each time you’ve taken that feat.
